name: basic-repo-standards
description: Audit a repository, app by app in a monorepo, against baseline hygiene standards (README, CLAUDE.md as discrete rule sections with coding standards + tech stack, CI coverage with named checks and main/master-safe branch triggers, secrets/.gitignore) and apply those hygiene fixes directly. Separately, per app, surface every codebase-structure gap grouped by pattern (lengthy files, mixed responsibilities, etc.) and ask whether to draft a refactoring plan — only that refactor work waits for explicit confirmation. Writes a BASIC_REPO_STANDARDS.md audit report.
